final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
final_draft.note: A live check on 2026-11-16 at 17:03 UTC found that EBS default encryption is on for account 111122223333, but it only looked at region us-east-1. Default encryption is set separately in each AWS region, so other regions weren't checked. The approved answer (valid until 2027-11-16) says nothing about regions. Another approved answer calls 111122223333 our production AWS account, but the approved answer used here doesn't say 'production' itself.
